demos.question: Total revenue from the 'Condiments' category during 'Summer Beverages 2017' as defined in the marketing calendar. Return a float rounded to 2 decimals.
demos.db_schema:
TABLES (col:type, * = primary key):
  Categories(CategoryID:int*, CategoryName:txt, Description:txt, Picture:blob)
  CustomerCustomerDemo(CustomerID:txt*, CustomerTypeID:txt*)  [EMPTY TABLE - 0 rows]
  CustomerDemographics(CustomerTypeID:txt*, CustomerDesc:txt)  [EMPTY TABLE - 0 rows]
  Customers(CustomerID:txt*, CompanyName:txt, ContactName:txt, ContactTitle:txt, Address:txt, City:txt, Region:txt, PostalCode:txt, Country:txt, Phone:txt, Fax:txt)
  EmployeeTerritories(EmployeeID:int*, TerritoryID:txt*)
  Employees(EmployeeID:int*, LastName:txt, FirstName:txt, Title:txt, TitleOfCourtesy:txt, BirthDate:date, HireDate:date, Address:txt, City:txt, Region:txt, PostalCode:txt, Country:txt, HomePhone:txt, Extension:txt, Photo:blob, Notes:txt, ReportsTo:int, PhotoPath:txt)
  "Order Details"(OrderID:int*, ProductID:int*, UnitPrice:num, Quantity:int, Discount:real)
  Orders(OrderID:int*, CustomerID:txt, EmployeeID:int, OrderDate:date, RequiredDate:date, ShippedDate:date, ShipVia:int, Freight:num, ShipName:txt, ShipAddress:txt, ShipCity:txt, ShipRegion:txt, ShipPostalCode:txt, ShipCountry:txt)
  Products(ProductID:int*, ProductName:txt, SupplierID:int, CategoryID:int, QuantityPerUnit:txt, UnitPrice:num, UnitsInStock:int, UnitsOnOrder:int, ReorderLevel:int, Discontinued:txt)
  Regions(RegionID:int*, RegionDescription:txt)
  Shippers(ShipperID:int*, CompanyName:txt, Phone:txt)
  Suppliers(SupplierID:int*, CompanyName:txt, ContactName:txt, ContactTitle:txt, Address:txt, City:txt, Region:txt, PostalCode:txt, Country:txt, Phone:txt, Fax:txt, HomePage:txt)
  Territories(TerritoryID:txt*, TerritoryDescription:txt, RegionID:int)
JOINS (foreign keys):
  CustomerCustomerDemo.CustomerTypeID -> CustomerDemographics.CustomerTypeID
  CustomerCustomerDemo.CustomerID -> Customers.CustomerID
  EmployeeTerritories.TerritoryID -> Territories.TerritoryID
  EmployeeTerritories.EmployeeID -> Employees.EmployeeID
  Employees.ReportsTo -> Employees.EmployeeID
  "Order Details".ProductID -> Products.ProductID
  "Order Details".OrderID -> Orders.OrderID
  Orders.ShipVia -> Shippers.ShipperID
  Orders.CustomerID -> Customers.CustomerID
  Orders.EmployeeID -> Employees.EmployeeID
  Products.SupplierID -> Suppliers.SupplierID
  Products.CategoryID -> Categories.CategoryID
  Territories.RegionID -> Regions.RegionID
demos.constraints:
DATE WINDOW: date(OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-06-01' AND '2017-06-30' (inclusive; from marketing_calendar::chunk1)
  COLUMN: OrderDate is a column of Orders only
FORMULA Revenue [unspecified]: SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity * (1 - Discount)) computed from order line items, using the line item unit price at time of sale, not the current catalog price
  COLUMN: Discount is a column of "Order Details" only
  COLUMN: Quantity is a column of "Order Details" only
  COLUMN: UnitPrice exists on "Order Details", Products - qualify it explicitly
DATES: OrderDate mixes 'YYYY-MM-DD' and 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; always wrap it as date(OrderDate) so the closing day is not dropped.
ENTITY GRAIN: group by the entity's id column (CustomerID, CategoryID, ProductID, EmployeeID, SupplierID) and select its display name.
REVENUE uses "Order Details".UnitPrice, never Products.UnitPrice.
demos.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - IFNULL(od.Discount, 0))), 2) AS TotalRevenue FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-06-01' AND '2017-06-30' AND c.CategoryName = 'Condiments'
